sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Alain is a name of the Fisher King. In the Grail lore, Alain is the father of Percival. He is named the Fisher King for a wonder of plenty, and he is the keeper of the Grail at the castle of Corbenic. The Fisher King is a King who, maimed, waits for a healing question.

okr.objective: Record Alain, a name of the Fisher King.
key_results: Show the link to Percival and the Grail.
